explain.1: Load PyTorch, so we can use torch.something.
explain.2: Load PyTorch's ready-made functions (softmax, cross_entropy) under the short name F.
explain.4: Our training text: the only thing Neo will learn from.
explain.5: set() keeps each character once. sorted() puts them in order. This is the vocabulary.
explain.6: len() counts the characters in the vocabulary.
explain.7: An empty dictionary. It will hold pairs like 'h' → 3.
explain.8: Another empty dictionary, for the reverse: 3 → 'h'.
explain.9: enumerate() gives each character with its position: 0 and the 1st character, 1 and the 2nd, and so on.
explain.10: Save this pair in the dictionary: character → number.
explain.14: An empty list for every 'this character'.
explain.15: An empty list for every 'next character' (the right answers).
explain.16: Go through every position in the text, except the last (it has nothing after it).
explain.17: Add this character's number to the list.
explain.18: Add the next character's number: the right answer.
explain.19: Turn the list into a tensor, so PyTorch can use it.
explain.23: Fix the random numbers, so you get the same result every time.
explain.24: The model: a table of random scores. requires_grad=True lets PyTorch find gradients for it.
explain.26: How big a step to take each time we fix the scores.
explain.27: Train 300 times: predict, measure, find directions, move.
explain.28: a) Predict: pick the row of scores for every 'this character'.
explain.29: b) Measure: how wrong were the scores? A smaller loss is better.
explain.30: Clear the old gradients before finding new ones.
explain.31: c) Find directions: PyTorch fills weights.grad with which way to move each score.
explain.32: d) Move: change each score a little, against its gradient.
explain.33: % is the remainder. This is true at steps 0, 50, 100, … so we print every 50 steps.
explain.34: Show the step number and the loss.
explain.37: Softmax turns each row of scores into chances that add up to 1.
explain.38: Take the row for 't': the chances of each character coming after 't'.
explain.39: Check three characters: space, full stop and 'h'.
explain.40: Show the character and its learned chance after 't'.
